- **Southern_Corn_Leaf_Blight**: Elongated rectangular brown lesions — different
- **Northern_Leaf_Blight**: Large cigar-shaped lesions — different

- **Anthracnose**: Dark/black elongated lesions with yellow halo — darker lesions than test
- **Tar_Spot**: Small black specks — different
- **Common_Rust**: Orange pustules — different

The test image most closely resembles **Holcus_Spot**: a single oval lesion with a gray/tan center and a distinctive bright yellow halo, on an otherwise green leaf with minor flecks. This matches the bacterial blight pattern of Holcus Spot better than any other class viewed.
